create.jei.andesite_golem.info: Andesite Golem: place a Carved Pumpkin (or Jack o'Lantern) on an Andesite Alloy Block. The golem appears and the block becomes its chest. Within 15 blocks of the chest it cuts trees (except ones with bee nests or hives) and harvests grown crops, replants them and stores what the chest filter accepts. Right-click it with Andesite Alloy to repair 25% of its health per alloy; Andesite Alloy kept in its chest is used the same way when it has lost at least that much and has not been hit for a few seconds. Right-click it or its chest with a blank Clipboard to note its status. At night, if its work area is not lit, it sleeps beside its chest until morning, slowly heals while asleep and hostile mobs leave it alone. Shift + Wrench picks up the chest with the golem. It also picks the flower that grows on top of a cactus (the cactus stays). Several golems near each other each take a different tree or crop. Right-click it with a Wrench to make it skip its current job for 30 seconds. With a Glass Bottle in its own slots it fills a honey bottle from a full beehive or bee nest; otherwise it takes 3 honeycomb. The bees stay calm.
create.jei.andesite_golem_chest.info: The filter slot is the small inset pad on the lid. Works with funnels, hoppers, packagers and comparators. A chest whose golem died turns cracked and can be pressed in a Mechanical Press into 6 Andesite Alloy. Last column: the golem's own 3 slots for Andesite Alloy and Glass Bottles; hoppers and other automation only see the 21 storage slots.
create.jei.packed_andesite_golem_chest.i: A golem's chest picked up while its golem was alive. Placing it brings the golem back with the same health, its chest contents, filter and carried items.

create.jei.netherite_golem.info: Netherite Golem: place a Carved Pumpkin or Jack o'Lantern on a Netherite Block. Guards 25 blocks from its chest, attacks all hostile monsters in sight, sleeps on its chest by day when safe and slowly heals while asleep, stores accepted kill drops. A creeper fighting it explodes without breaking blocks. Right-click it with a Netherite Ingot to repair 20 HP (Ancient Debris: 10 HP); Netherite Ingots kept in its chest are used the same way out of combat.
create.jei.netherite_golem_chest.info: Unfiltered chest stores all kill drops; a filter limits only stored loot. Shift + Wrench packs a live golem. Dead chest presses into six Netherite Ingots. Last column: the golem's own 3 slots for Netherite Ingots and Ancient Debris, used to repair it; automation only sees the 21 storage slots.
Moving the packed chest preserves age, health, contents and filter, but resets monster kills.

create.jei.redstone_golem.info: Redstone Golem: place a Carved Pumpkin or Jack o'Lantern on a Block of Redstone; the block becomes its chest. Its only job is collecting: it runs to the fullest chest on its network, takes up to 4 stacks, walks back and stores them in its chest. It stops while its chest has no empty slot. The fastest and most fragile golem. Right-click it or its chest with a blank Clipboard to note its status. Shift + Wrench picks up the chest with the golem. Right-click it with Redstone Dust to repair 2 HP; Redstone Dust in its chest is used the same way when it is hurt. Right-click it with a Wrench to make it skip its current source chest for 30 seconds. It only collects from, and delivers to, network chests within 128 blocks of its own chest.
create.jei.redstone_golem_chest.info: Network: right-click this chest with a Stock Link to tune the link to its network, then Shift + right-click the tuned link onto a chest or another golem's chest to make it a source. Only loaded chests within 128 blocks of its chest are visited; its own chest never is. No filter: everything is stored. Works with funnels, hoppers, packagers and comparators. A chest whose golem died can be pressed into 6 Redstone Dust. The latch on the front of a golem chest turns bright red while that chest is part of a Redstone network. First column: items to share. The golem takes them along to the golem chests of its network that use them (Andesite Alloy, Netherite Ingots, Ancient Debris, Redstone Dust, Glass Bottles), giving most to whoever has least, and brings back what does not fit. Last column: its own Redstone Dust. Automation only sees the 18 storage slots.
create.jei.packed_redstone_golem_chest.i: Moving the packed chest keeps the golem's health and age, the chest contents, what it carried and its network: tuned Stock Links keep working. Right-click another Redstone Golem Chest with it to join that chest's network instead (Shift + right-click places it); then both golems collect from the same chests without competing for them.

create.jei.andesite_revival_pumpkin.info: Andesite Revival Pumpkin: craft a Carved Pumpkin in the middle with three Andesite Alloy in the row below it. Place it on top of a Andesite Golem Chest without a golem (a placed chest, or one whose golem died): it becomes an Andesite Golem living off that chest, which keeps everything it had (contents, filter, network). It cannot be placed on a chest that still has a golem or on another material's chest. Anywhere else it is a decorative block.
create.jei.netherite_revival_pumpkin.inf: Netherite Revival Pumpkin: craft a Carved Pumpkin in the middle with three Netherite Ingots in the row below it. Place it on top of a Netherite Golem Chest without a golem (a placed chest, or one whose golem died): it becomes a Netherite Golem living off that chest, which keeps everything it had (contents, filter, network). It cannot be placed on a chest that still has a golem or on another material's chest. Anywhere else it is a decorative block.
create.jei.redstone_revival_pumpkin.info: Redstone Revival Pumpkin: craft a Carved Pumpkin in the middle with three Redstone Dust in the row below it. Place it on top of a Redstone Golem Chest without a golem (a placed chest, or one whose golem died): it becomes a Redstone Golem living off that chest, which keeps everything it had (contents, filter, network). It cannot be placed on a chest that still has a golem or on another material's chest. Anywhere else it is a decorative block.
